english.note: Use this when someone deliberately indicates or announces an intention, attitude, or decision.

exampleSentences.english: They raised their hand to signify opposition.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 geoi2 sau2 biu2 si6 faan2 deoi3

english.note: Use this especially for expressing an attitude, position, intention, or reaction.

exampleSentences.english: They use their actions to express their support for us.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋用行動表示支持我哋。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 hang4 dung6 biu2 si6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6
